MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

4. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   B. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.

5. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

7. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.

8. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

10. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Singing Games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Elements of Music RESPONDING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
